props.study_text: A man-eating demon that lives off the mountain's leavings — travellers who strayed, and whatever Fafnir did not finish. It does not hunt so much as collect: bodies, and the weapons found on them. Every arm holds something somebody died holding.
props.traits: Collector · Patient · Eats what it kills · Never the same twice
